title: docs(skills): teach the five-step locale ladder resolveLocaleAmong runs
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DAi5Z7YR39qhBJcWtjJwHtT)_

Fixes #30603

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-i18n` 技能里讲内存兜底语言匹配顺序的那一句,从旧的四步改成代码实际跑的五步,并点名 `resolveLocaleAmong`,给出 `zh-TW` → `zh-Hant` 的例子。
- 为什么改:PR #30601 让两个服务端解析器共用 `resolveLocaleAmong`,在大小写不敏感和基础语言之间加了“平台语言表”一步;旧句子会让 AI 以为 `zh-TW` 落到第一个注册的 `zh-*`(可能是简体)。
- 风险与回滚:只改一句文档加一个 changeset,不动代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 第 376–379 行那一处 hunk。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-i18n/SKILL`,预期 5718 tokens(上限 6333,未抬上限)。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(`skills/**`),请在席位契约复核通过后审批合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: the sentence on the in-memory fallback's locale matching now names the ladder `resolveLocaleAmong` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) runs, the one `resolveBundleLocale` also runs, in the code's order: exact, case-insensitive, same platform-table language (`zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`), base language, first registered variant. One root changeset, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. No other skill text changes; no eval case added (the eval fixtures carry no locale-ladder case, and the card scopes the sentence alone).

The five steps are read off `origin/main` `b77c160a`: `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (`resolveLocaleAmong`, steps 1 to 5) and its test `resolveLocaleAmong answers the same over a list` (`zh-TW` among `en, zh-CN, zh-Hant` answers `zh-Hant`); core's `resolveLocale` in `packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts` returns `resolveLocaleAmong` directly.

## Tests

Docs-only diff under `skills/**`; no package code or test changes, so no package test or typecheck owed.

## Acceptance notes

- Token readings (ceil(utf8 bytes / 4), release-stamp line excluded), whole file: `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 5673 → 5718 tokens (+45), ceiling 6333 unchanged, headroom 660 → 615. Lines 520 → 522; bytes 22712 → 22891.
- Whole package: bundle total (whole shipped tree) 226234 → 226279 tokens (+45); all `SKILL.md` files summed 4534 → 4536 lines.
- The +45 is paid inside the existing ceiling's headroom; no ceiling raised. The dispatch pins "no other skill text changes", so no same-file deletion elsewhere in the skill was made.

- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0; `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md is 5718 tokens (ceiling 6333; headroom 615)`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.
- Five families first exited 3 (prerequisite: no dist): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`.
